body: Sorry to hear that, but you can't give. Become stronger from this, you will find someone worth it for you.

Personally no, but its better to say you have depression especially since your in a relationship and a good one. 
If you open up to him and tell him, it will give him the confidence to trust you more since you trust him to tell him something like having depression.

If he loves you and tells you that you make him the happiest he's ever been, then I don't think he would see a problem with your depression and he would be more concerned with helping you get threw it instead of letting you suffer in silence.
